About the provider

Consultancy built on the dyehouse floor, not just the lecture hall

AJTEX Consultants is a Karachi-based, results-driven consultancy rooted in the textile sector, with a vision to serve businesses across diverse industries. It combines strategic insight with practical, hands-on expertise to support sustainable and scalable growth — from the dyehouse floor to the boardroom.

The consultancy is led by Dr. Abdul Jabbar, who brings 27 years of experience spanning academia, research and industry, specialising in Colour Science, Polymers, Dyestuff Chemistry and Fibre Modification. His background, rooted in a PhD from the University of Leeds, underpins a career dedicated to innovation and sustainable practice.

Core expertise

Dyeing is where this practice began

AJTEX's sustainability work starts in the dye bath. Dr. Jabbar's own doctoral research at the University of Leeds focused on environment-friendly dyeing of cotton — pre-treating cellulose fibre with cross-linking agents and using modified reactive dyes to improve the efficiency of conventional reactive dyeing.

That same thinking now runs through AJTEX's dyehouse productivity audits and its work on dye and chemical consumption optimisation: using less water, less chemical and less energy for the same depth of shade — and passing that know-how on to client teams.

Illustrative animation — fabric moves through successive, low-water dye stages, the kind of cycle AJTEX audits for efficiency on client dyehouse floors.
Founder & CEO

Meet Dr. Abdul Jabbar

Dr. Abdul Jabbar
Founder & CEO, AJTEX Consultants

Dr. Jabbar has actively fostered academia-industry relationships, secured R&D grants, and organised numerous national and international conferences. With an entrepreneurial mindset and strong industry ties, he is a qualified sustainability manager, proficient in effluent management and sustainability reporting. His expertise extends to quality assurance, having served as Director QEC and a trained IPE auditor for HEC.

He is also a Certified DfS Practitioner — trained in 2025 through NED University of Engineering & Technology and GIZ's own Dialogue for Sustainability programme, the same methodology he now delivers to client companies.

PhD, Univ. of Leeds (1998) Chartered Colourist, SDC Bradford (2003) Certified DfS Practitioner, NED + GIZ (2025) Sustainability Manager, Saarland, Germany (2023) Dean Academics & Research, TIP Karachi (2014–2024)
